title: Voters turned on data centers, and AI stocks lost $2.3 trillion
short:
Wall Street wiped about $2.3 trillion off AI stocks in a day. The trigger was voters.
Local ballots went against data centers almost everywhere.
Full story: https://badeifer.github.io/news/ai-selloff-data-center-ballots/

Thursday's record tech selloff was not about chatbots. The Nasdaq 100 fell 6.3 percent, Nvidia 9.2 and the Philadelphia chip index 12.3, after local voters sided against data centers in all but one of 41 ballot measures and new governors in Texas, Georgia and Ohio backed pauses or limits.
